code='''from collections import Counter

def _stripe_lines(grid, axis):
    n = len(grid) if axis == 0 else len(grid[0])
    width = len(grid[0]) if axis == 0 else len(grid)
    marks = []
    for i in range(n):
        vals = [grid[i][j] for j in range(width)] if axis == 0 else [grid[j][i] for j in range(width)]
        nonzero = Counter(v for v in vals if v != 0)
        if nonzero and max(nonzero.values()) >= (width + 1) // 2:
            marks.append(i)
    return marks

def _keep(n, marks):
    out = []
    start = 0
    for p in marks:
        if p > start:
            out.append(start)
        out.append(p)
        start = p + 1
    if start < n:
        out.append(start)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    ri = _keep(len(grid), _stripe_lines(grid, 0))
    ci = _keep(len(grid[0]), _stripe_lines(grid, 1))
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in ci] for r in ri]
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code, str(p), 'exec'))
print(_stripe_lines(demo,0), _stripe_lines(demo,1), transform(demo))
